title: Bonus $10 Costco Shop Card for Turning on Auto Renewal for Costco Membership (Limit of 1 per Membership) @ Costco
body:
Deal: Bonus $10 Costco Shop Card for Turning on Auto Renewal for Costco Membership (Limit of 1 per Membership) @ Costco

[spock] Well guess what ive been trying to turn on auto renewal for weeks & it does not work on the site ive also contacted support twice & they dont reply to emails so this isn't worth anything & how about fixing your site costco .
[trixieb] Just turned on auto-renewal today in my Costco app. Did you try the Costco app?
[Bappy] FYI - I believe this is one time redemption only (per user).
I redeemed this offer last year and enquired again this year (my membership is about to be expired), and the lady at Members Service advised I cannot claim this offer again this year although I did turn off auto renewal since last membership got renewed.
YMMV.
[mclachat] I can confirm the Epping store in Melbourne offers a digital gift card. I shopped on Sunday and received the e-gift card today.
[browser] They check history now, was able to on off on off on off many times through the years.
[Techefy] What’s the recent type with Costco? Two back to back deals on the front page?
[trixieb] I am the poster and planned it that way.
[pyramid] My membership expires 2 weeks back…aah poor timings
[King Steuart] Boomers gonna boom boom boom boom boom boom
[carrawa] I guess too many people cutting costs and getting caught by the auto-renewal cycle when they stopped using it.
Only really worth it if you have car or access to one or they have very close public transport.
Try getting to the North Lakes one by public transport and back to see what I mean (unless the public transport has improved and stop options). It was mainly the connection bus from I think Dakabin to North Lakes.
Removed a lot from the options. Hot Chickens and large packet of Kirkwood chips were good, pius sometimes some deals, but the hassles of getting there plus getting everything back just made it too hard in my case.
The receipt thing at/before the door needs to be sorted out, embarassing and a pain in the butt if you don't/didn't know and had to search which bag I put the receipt in. Know your market!
